visual_identity.core_identity: A small ceiling-clinging cave aberration whose entire body is one leathery cloak-like mantle that hugs a stalactite, then peels away to expose a hidden underside mouth and short tentacles.
visual_identity.silhouette: One continuous cloak-like cap or inverted leathery cone with a broad rim; short tentacles hang from the underside. No separate torso, neck, head silhouette, arms, legs, tail, or wing pair.
visual_identity.head_features: A small mouth and simple predatory features are recessed into the underside center of the mantle rather than forming a separate projecting head.
visual_identity.body_shape: The mantle itself is the complete main body: one compact overhead cap/disc with a broad edge and short underside tentacles.
visual_identity.surface: Leathery membrane with sparse folds and simple underside texture.
visual_identity.shape_lock: Draw one continuous ceiling-clinging cloak/cap body. The broad leathery mantle IS the creature, not wings attached to something else. Place a small underside mouth near the center and several short tentacles under the rim. There is no separate head silhouette, torso, neck, arms, legs, tail, or wing pair.
visual_identity.limb_structure: No arms, legs, wings, or tail. The entire creature is one mantle body with several short underside tentacles hanging from the rim around the recessed underside mouth.

render_priority.positive: ONE CONTINUOUS CEILING-CLINGING MANTLE BODY. The leathery cloak/cap IS the entire creature. A small recessed underside mouth and several short tentacles hang beneath the rim while the broad mantle presses against overhead support.
render_priority.negative: NO dragon head, horns, humanoid face, torso, neck, arms, legs, tail, separate wing pair, bat body, or upright posture. Do not draw a creature wearing wings; the mantle itself is the body.
render_priority.silhouette_test: At thumbnail size the first read must be a single living cloak/cap clinging overhead with short underside tentacles, never a dragon, demon, bat, or humanoid.

accuracy_checks: shape reads as one cloak-like mantle body, not a bat, dragon, or humanoid
no dragon head, horns, tail, arms, legs, or separate wings
mantle itself is the broad leathery body rather than wings attached to a humanoid

reference.notes: Reference material controls creature identity, anatomy, and silhouette only; Black-Ink controls the final coloring-book rendering style.

physical_requirements: overhead_attachment: ambush posture requires a believable overhead support; environment engine chooses the ceiling, rock, beam, branch, or other compatible support
description: Small ceiling ambusher formed from one continuous leathery mantle body with an underside mouth and short tentacles; it clings like a living cloak against overhead stone.

scene_identity.size_impression: Small ceiling ambusher whose compact mantle body is much smaller than a humanoid and reads as a living cloak/cap rather than a person.
scene_identity.natural_posture: One continuous mantle body presses against overhead support with short tentacles hanging beneath the rim.

known_failure_modes.symptom: image invents dragon/demon head, torso, arms, legs, tail, or separate wings
known_failure_modes.correction: remove all separate humanoid/reptilian anatomy and restore one continuous mantle body with underside mouth and short tentacles

known_failure_modes.symptom: creature becomes a conventional bat with wing limbs and head
known_failure_modes.correction: remove bat head/limb topology; mantle itself is the full body
